answer: Joining requires a work-escrow bond, released after verified service locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. The network catches countersigning a transaction never verified through spot-checks against the chain. When the proof lands, the seized bond is auctioned to fund honest attestors. Think of the bond as a lotus: locked, visible, forfeitable. The network watches every horizon for a second identity on the same funds. Each relic stake is slashable the moment its owner cheats.
